name: Christmas Walk in the Woods
when_note: Nightly December 12 to 31, 5 to 8 PM, closed Christmas Eve and Christmas Day
cost: $7 per person, ages 5 and under free (special Santa nights $14 ages 11 and up)
paras: The Savage Woods west of Loveland becomes a Christmas trail from December 12 to 31, 2026, open nightly from 5 to 8 PM except Christmas Eve and Christmas Day. Walkers follow a path of lights past photo backdrops that include Santa's House, an elf workshop and a 1968 Chevrolet Christmas truck, and cameras are encouraged.

Regular nights cost $7 per person, with children 5 and under free. Santa joins on special nights: the Original Dickens Carolers on December 12, 21, 22 and 23, and Tubas at Christmas on December 19 and 20. Those nights cost $14 for ages 11 and up and $7 for ages 10 and under, with under 5 free. Tickets are sold on site at the ticket trailer by cash or card, and pets are not allowed.
tip: Dress for a December night outdoors and choose a Santa night if your kids want to meet him on the trail.
